title: Campaign preflight does not validate selected owner continuity before source/canonical writes
cause: Source prepare validates the native checkpoint internally but only tests old-path continuity for promotions. It does not require each selected existing owner preimage to equal the last native owner-chain endpoint. Publisher _receipt validates row replay but not the prospective native owner chain; old-policy historical==current-preimage skips its optional bridge branch. Native _owner_chains is only invoked after canonical/policy writes in completed validation.
source_reproduction: A valid native checkpoint links Existing.yaml to endpointB while current exact accepted beforeimage isA. Real source prepare/apply/verify_completed all report success and mutate the owner; no mocked source proof.
publisher_reproduction: With valid prefix and proposed A->C transition after historical endpointB, dry-run returns dry_run. Real native row/receipt/policy publication then changes canonical and policy before completed validation raises Owner receipt chain has a gap. Success receipts are correctly cleared, but the known invalid transition was not rejected before mutation. This publisher fixture explicitly isolates owner proof/generation; native replay/chain and writes are real.
positive_control: Matched native endpoint equals proposed beforeimage: dry-run and apply succeed.
required_fix: Before any source/publication writes, prove selected existing preimages equal applicable native latest owner endpoints, and validate the complete prospective native owner chain (including create/promote destination history) in preflight. Retain refusal for unsupported promotion migrations. Do not rebase or overwrite history to make the fixture pass. Add positive bridge and deterministic disconnected-history cases asserting no data mutation.
limitations: Private fixture results only; no actual campaign data or author files changed. This is a preflight failure, not a claim that the publisher left a success receipt.
